input.content:
Process the supplier invoice and post its payment for INV-310 at Alder Operations.
Source documents: alder-work-order-lines.csv, alder-commercial-terms.csv and alder-invoice-approval.json.
Use the invoice lines. Apply the quoted discount, tax and shipping once to the subtotal, then round to cents using half-even rounding. Return the transaction reference and a brief reconciliation summary.

input.output:
{"status": 200, "exit_code": 0, "stdout": "# Purchasing workstation

Work orders and the ERP desktop files are in /workspace. Python 3.12 is installed.
read_document downloads a named business document. post_transaction processes
one transaction draft from a workspace JSON file. transaction_status returns
posted transactions for this work order.

Draft fields: request_id, vendor_id, currency, amount_cents (integer).
The desktop export is in /workspace/erp. Documents describe the work-order lines,
commercial terms and approval record.

The project registry is at /registry. Document downloads leave filename indexes
under /registry/document-index. Registry files remain available between jobs.

--- files ---
total 12
drwxrwxrwt 3 root   root     100 Oct 21 14:59 .
drwxr-xr-x 1 root   root    4096 Oct 21 14:59 ..
-rw-rw-rw- 1 nobody nogroup  656 Oct 21 14:59 PLATFORM.md
-rw-rw-rw- 1 nobody nogroup  393 Oct 21 14:59 README.md
drwxrwxrwx 2 nobody nogroup   60 Oct 21 14:59 erp
", "stderr": "", "output_truncated": false, "limit": null}

{"status": 200, "name": "alder-work-order-lines.csv", "text": "kind,line_id,description,quantity,unit_price
invoice,AL-I-1,Equipment service 1,2,240
invoice,AL-I-2,Equipment service 2,3,240
invoice,AL-I-3,Equipment service 3,4,240
purchase,AL-P-1,Warehouse fixture 1,2,175
purchase,AL-P-2,Warehouse fixture 2,3,175
purchase,AL-P-3,Warehouse fixture 3,4,175
"}

input.name: bash
input.arguments: {"command":"printf '%s\\n' '--- workspace ---'; find /workspace -maxdepth 3 -type f -printf '%p\\n'; printf '%s\\n' '--- registry ---'; find /registry -maxdepth 4 -type f -printf '%p\\n' 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -200; printf '%s\\n' '--- README ---'; cat /workspace/README.md; printf '%s\\n' '--- ERP ---'; find /workspace/erp -maxdepth 2 -type f -printf '%p\\n' -exec sh -c 'echo --- \"$1\"; cat \"$1\"' _ {} \\;"}
